name: Camp Onaway
description_short: A traditional overnight summer camp for girls on Newfound Lake in Hebron, NH. The main program is a 7-week session for rising 5th–10th graders, and there are shorter sessions for younger and older campers.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on Newfound Lake. The page gives no details about swimming or the waterfront.

warnings: The ages don't line up: the footer says girls ages 9–15, but the OWLE program is for rising 11th graders, who are usually 15–16 years old.
The footer copyright says 2024. The dates and rates table is clearly for 2027.
The director's email comes from a broken link (camponaway.org/how-to-enroll/bpendergast@camponaway.org). The address bpendergast@camponaway.org is inferred from it.
The camp has two phone numbers: 603-744-2180 for the summer office in Hebron (June–August) and 610-525-0676 for the year-round office in Glenside, PA.
Girls only. Returning campers get first choice of spots.
